description: This file contains various converter classes used for transforming between different data representations related to Apache OFBiz entities. It includes converters for JSON to GenericValue, GenericValue to JSON, collections of GenericValue objects, and null value handling.

classes.name: JSONToGenericValue
classes.description: Converts a JSON object to a GenericValue instance by mapping JSON fields to entity fields and handling type conversions.

classes.name: GenericValueToJSON
classes.description: Converts a GenericValue instance into a JSON object, embedding entity and delegator metadata.

classes.name: GenericValueToList
classes.description: Wraps a single GenericValue into a List collection.

classes.name: GenericValueToSet
classes.description: Wraps a single GenericValue into a Set collection.

classes.name: GenericValueToString
classes.description: Converts a GenericValue to its String representation.

classes.name: NullFieldToObject
classes.description: Converts a NullField to a null Object.

classes.name: ObjectToNullField
classes.description: Converts any Object to a NullField marker.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Performs conversion logic for each converter class, transforming input data to the target type.
